Minecraft is an open-world survival game. Uniquely, it does not follow a storyline; rather it presents each player with the challenge of simply existing in the blocky wilderness alongside a wide array of livestock and monsters. entry.title: Find the Diamond... or Die Trying!

media:group.media:title: Find the Diamond... or Die Trying!
media:group.media:description:
Descend into the caves and choose your path. This is a Minecraft-inspired choose-your-own-adventure series where every video connects to the next through the end screen. At the end of each route, you’ll choose left or right and continue deeper through underground tunnels, abandoned structures, flooded caverns, lava chambers, unstable passageways, and creature-filled darkness.
Your goal is to find the diamonds. But it won’t be easy. The sequence has been designed so that fewer than 1% of viewers will reach them on a first run, which means every decision matters. One wrong turn can leave you lost, drowned, burned, ambushed, or dead long before you ever reach the treasure.
This project was brought to life through a combination of AI-generated visuals and traditional animation techniques, which allowed me to create something larger and more ambitious than anything I’ve made before. More than anything, I hope you enjoy it for what it is: an interactive adventure built around my own characters, storytelling, and creative vision.
If the end screen doesn’t appear, use the links below to continue:
